passages.title: Pump P-200 start-up
passages.text: Before starting pump P-200, open the suction valve fully, check that the casing is primed, then start the motor and open the discharge valve slowly within 30 seconds.

passages.title: Pump P-200 vibration limits
passages.text: Normal vibration for pump P-200 is below 4.5 mm/s RMS. Between 4.5 and 7.1 mm/s schedule an inspection within 7 days. Above 7.1 mm/s stop the pump and inspect bearings.

passages.title: Compressor C-110 oil change
passages.text: Change the oil of compressor C-110 every 4000 operating hours using ISO VG 46 oil. Drain while warm and replace the oil filter at each change.

passages.title: Conveyor B-7 belt tension
passages.text: Check conveyor B-7 belt tension weekly. Belt sag must not exceed 2 percent of the span between idlers.

passages.title: Lockout-tagout
passages.text: Before any maintenance, isolate all energy sources, apply a personal lock and tag, and verify zero energy by attempting a start.

passages.title: Bearing temperature
passages.text: Bearing temperature on motors must stay below 85 degrees Celsius. Above 95 degrees Celsius trip the motor and inspect lubrication.

passages.title: Heat exchanger E-301 cleaning
passages.text: Clean heat exchanger E-301 when the approach temperature rises by more than 5 degrees Celsius above the clean baseline.

passages.title: Work order priorities
passages.text: Priority P1 means safety risk or production stop, fix within 4 hours. P2 means degraded operation, fix within 24 hours. P3 is planned maintenance within 7 days.

E101.action: Check suction valve and strainer for blockage.

E102.action: Stop the pump and inspect bearings.

E205.action: Stop the compressor and check oil level and pump.

E210.action: Schedule oil change with ISO VG 46 oil.
